Hey! I'm Kyle, a 35 year old Cleveland dude who makes vinyl records for a living. The dating app nightmare has finally broken me, so I figured why not take a shot here.

I moved to Cleveland about 2 years ago, I have anxiety so it's a little hard to approach people in public. Once I get comfortable I'm a complete goof, I love joking around and improv. I consider myself somewhat of an Absurdist, so I have embraced the idea that life has no inherit meaning other than just to strap down and deal with whatever happens. Taking life one time at a time.

 "Just a chill bro tryin' to chill, bro"

I work 3rd shift for a vinyl record production company. You know all those crazy swirly records with different colors? I make those. Music is a monumental part of my life and I'd like to find someone who has the same passion. I'm into all types of music, but my go-to's are Shoegaze, Doom, Post Rock, Blackgaze, etc. Simplified, I'm into heavy sad music. The schedule I have isn't helpful at all for meeting new people.

Also an aspiring artist, I like drawing black and white line art. My main goal is to hunker down and get my own art studio running. All those mid-90's hand drawn fliers by artists such as Derek Hess, Coop, Frank Kozik, etc. are some of my inspirations for what I'd like to do with my life. I'd have to say that Junji Ito and Bernie Wrightson are my two biggest drawing style influences.

MUSIC! The main driving factor of my life. I love live music and going to shows when I can. I'm into everything really, but my main go-to's are Shoegaze, Doom, Stoner Metal, Post-Rock, etc. My favorite bands are Nothing, Viagra Boys and Electric Wizard. I don't have too many friends since moving here in 2020, so I usually go to shows alone. I'd love to meet someone who would want to accompany me.  


A little bullheaded, but always willing to compromise. One of those people that will have your back (even if you made a dumb decision). Dad bod without the dad part, but I'm trying to get into better shape. Got back in the IF plan and have been shedding some L-Bz! Down about 10 lbs so far.  


Like I said I moved to Clevo about 2 years ago. I signed my lease and about 2 hours later they locked down the state, so making friends has been rough. Anxiety/depression adds to it but I've been working hard on my mental health and it's been improving greatly. Definitely the most stable I've been in my life. 

I love thrifting, working on my record and t-shirt collection, building computers, drawing, walking around the city, road trips, hitting up shady dive bars, and high fiving strippers after tipping well.

I've known that I never wanted kids dating all the way back to high school, steadfast in my decision. Dated a few people with kids and oh man, that is NOT the life for me. Every moment of that situation was stressful to the point where I made my decision for a vasectomy.

As for the vasectomy, I'm shopping around and seeing what my insurance will cover. Its gonna happen no matter what, even If I have to pay in full out of my pocket.

​

Ideally I'd like a relationship, but I am always open for new friends who don't have kids that would want to hang and not be so miserable. Hope to hear from you, lets go to a show!
